ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/off-white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-intensity central region. High-contrast white geometric blobs localized on the distal-lateral tips of both lobes. The left lobe displays a larger, roughly triangular white patch with interior dark mottling; the right lobe displays a narrow, elongated white band along the distal edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a medium bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the distal half of both lobes. Micro-peaks (3-5 pixels) interspersed with jagged, uneven valleys; right lobe displays more pronounced, sawtooth-like topography compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into a sharp convex taper at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-relief, high-contrast textured bumps (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer-most lateral edge of the left lobe and smaller clusters along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, roughly vertical dark linear pixel disruptions visible within the white pigmentation zone of the left lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily irregular and jagged trailing edge suggesting cumulative physical wear; significant barnacle encrustation on the left lobe terminal tip.
